title: Fixture: every interactive block
description: Fixture for the build tests: one example of every built block.
tldr: Steps you can tick, a phone that rings as you scroll, tabs for code.
Tables, questions, choices and problems you can open one by one.
Every block still reads as plain text without JavaScript.
markdown: ## Why approvals need one owner An agent that deletes data needs a person to say yes first. This post shows how. > Never auto-approve when the answer is missing. ## Set it up 1. Create a channel in M91. What you should see: a send link. 2. Add the link to your server raw-in-block. 3. Send a test alert. ## How the approval flows 1. The agent reaches a risky step and asks for approval. 2. M91 rings the on-call phone. 3. The person taps Approve. 4. The software continues with the step. ## Send the alert ```bash curl -sS -X POST "$M91_SEND_LINK" -d '{"title":"Deploy 4821"}' ``` ```js await fetch(process.env.M91_SEND_LINK, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ title: 'Deploy 4821' }) }) ``` ## Compare the options | Option | Wakes a person | Records the answer | |---|---|---| | Slack message | No | No | | M91 call | Yes | Yes | ## What happens if nobody answers 1. Minute 0: the phone rings. 2. Minute 5: the next person is called. 3. Minute 15: the team lead is called. ## A run, step by step ```console $ agent run deploy waiting for approval… approved by Aryan deploy 4821 done ``` ## Pick a timeout **Short timeout** and the agent gives up quickly: nothing changes. **Long timeout** and the agent waits for a person. That keeps risky steps safe. ## Questions ### Does M91 work in silent mode? Yes. It rings through silent mode. ### Can two people approve? Only the first answer counts. ## Troubleshooting ### The phone does not ring Likely cause: the app has no permission to ring. Fix: allow notifications for M91. ### The callback never arrives Likely cause: the callback URL is not public. Fix: use a public HTTPS URL. ## What to do next [Try M91](https://m91-site.embarko.app/)
